description: Activation and behavior cases for manual or automated smoke tests in each client. 'expect' lists observable behavior, not exact wording. Behavior cases assume an authorized test repository and the whole Defense Factory plugin installed.

activation.prompt: Do a Defense Factory review of this repository.
Run a Defense Factory review on services/api.
Start a Defense Factory security review of this repo.
Find security bugs in this repository.
Review this pull request for security issues.
Fix the path traversal in upload.py.

behavior.name: happy path
behavior.prompt: Do a Defense Factory review of this repository.
expect: says once that it will run stage 1 then stage 2 and that stage 2 can take long
asks no authorization or output-location question
runs the threat-model skill, then the finding-discovery skill without asking in between
both stages write into the same .defense-factory/runs/<run_id>/ folder
stage 2 records authorization as inherited from stage 1 run <run_id>
ends with one summary covering both stages, the overall status, and that stage 3 is not available yet

behavior.name: missing stage skill
behavior.setup: Only the defense-factory-review and threat-model skills are installed.
behavior.prompt: Do a Defense Factory review of this repository.
expect: says the finding-discovery skill is missing

behavior.name: not authorized
behavior.prompt: Do a Defense Factory review of this repo. I don't have the owner's permission.

behavior.name: stop after stage 1
behavior.prompt: Do a Defense Factory review of this repository, but stop after the threat model.
expect: says stage 2 can be run later on its own

behavior.name: stage 1 blocked
behavior.setup: The target folder cannot be read.
behavior.prompt: Do a Defense Factory review of /path/that/is/unreadable.
